aboutPage.title: 20 Years of Elevation, Trust and Safety.
aboutPage.intro: Welcome to Canaj Lift, your trusted provider of advanced elevator solutions. For over 20 years, we have built a strong reputation for quality and outstanding service, becoming one of the leaders in Albania's elevator industry.
aboutPage.whoText: With a dedicated team of more than 40 professionals, Canaj Lift brings deep expertise and experience to every project. We believe in continually developing our team so our clients benefit from the latest technologies and best practices in the elevator industry.
aboutPage.whatIntro: We offer a full range of services to meet our clients' needs:

installation.title: Elevator Installation
installation.description: We install an average of 20 elevators each month to high quality and safety standards. Alongside our own projects, we also carry out installations for other elevator companies.

maintenance.title: Maintenance and Repairs
maintenance.description: With more than 400 elevators under maintenance, we help ensure safe, uninterrupted operation, minimize downtime and extend equipment service life.

modernization.title: Modernization and Upgrades
modernization.description: We improve the performance and safety of existing elevators with modern technology and solutions tailored to each project.

aboutPage.valuesIntro: Our success comes from our commitment to quality, our clients and professionalism.

quality.title: Quality and Innovation
quality.description: We use advanced technology to deliver efficient, safe and reliable elevators.

client.title: Customer Service
client.description: We listen to and understand your needs to provide tailored solutions and exceptional service.

professionalism.title: Commitment and Professionalism
professionalism.description: Our trained and certified team works professionally on every project and service.

aboutPage.closingTitle: Quality that takes you higher. Service that keeps you there.
aboutPage.closingText: From installation and maintenance to modernization, our team is with you at every stage of your project.

intro.title: Home Elevators (Home Lifts)
intro.description: At Canaj Lift, we bring comfort and luxury to your home with our home elevators, also known as home lifts. They provide comfortable, safe and stylish vertical transport, improve access to every floor and add value to your property.

design.title: Bespoke Design and Modern Aesthetics
design.description: Our home elevators are tailored to each client's individual taste and needs. We offer a wide range of designs and materials to complement your home's style and interior:

items.title: Elegant, modern design:
items.text: Our home lifts are a stylish addition to any home, with a sophisticated, contemporary look.

items.title: Custom options:
items.text: Cabins, doors and control panels can be customized to meet your requirements.

safety.title: Safety and Reliability
safety.description: Safety is our top priority. Our home lifts are equipped with advanced systems to ensure safe, reliable operation:

items.title: Integrated safety systems:
items.text: Sensors, emergency brakes and emergency communication help protect users.

items.title: Certifications and high standards:
items.text: Our home lifts are built to industry standards and certified for safety and quality.

efficiency.title: Energy Efficiency and Advanced Technology
efficiency.description: Our home elevators are designed for efficient energy use and high performance:

items.title: Efficient drive systems:
items.text: Advanced motors and systems reduce energy consumption and operating costs.

items.title: Sustainable technology:
items.text: We aim to use sustainable technology and materials to minimize environmental impact.

tailored.title: Tailored Solutions for Every Villa
tailored.description: Whether you are building a new villa or renovating an existing one, we provide solutions tailored to your needs:

items.title: Installation in existing buildings:
items.text: Our home lifts can be installed in existing buildings without major structural changes.

items.title: New construction:
items.text: We work closely with architects and builders to integrate the elevator seamlessly into your new home's design.

items.title: Improved accessibility:
items.text: A home lift provides easy, safe access to every floor, including for people with limited mobility.

items.title: Increased property value:
items.text: A home lift adds value and appeal while bringing luxury and comfort to your home.

items.title: Everyday convenience:
items.text: Move around your home with ease and enjoy greater comfort every day.

intro.title: Stair Lifts & Access Platforms
intro.description: A stair lift platform helps people with limited mobility move between floors more independently. Canaj Lift provides solutions planned around the available space, stair configuration and user's needs.

platform.title: Easy Movement on Stairs
platform.description: The platform travels along the stairs and can be adapted for wheelchair use, depending on the project configuration.

items.title: Fits the staircase:
items.text: The solution is planned according to the shape and dimensions of the stairs.

items.title: Wheelchair access:
items.text: The platform offers a practical way to move between floors without using the stairs on foot.

safety.title: Safety and Control
safety.description: Equipment selection and installation take everyday use and the specific conditions of the building into account.

items.title: Controlled operation:
items.text: Clear controls make it easier to start and stop the platform.

items.title: Professional installation:
items.text: Assessment and installation by specialists help ensure the solution is suitable for the space and user.

installation.title: Designed for Existing Spaces
installation.description: Every project begins with an assessment of the staircase and access at the entry and exit points to identify a suitable solution.

items.title: Site assessment:
items.text: We review the stair configuration, available space and intended use.

items.title: Project-specific solution:
items.text: Dimensions and placement are determined based on the building conditions and the user's needs.

tailored.title: The Right Solution for Every Building
tailored.description: Needs differ from one space to another. Our team can help you assess the options and select a suitable platform.

items.title: For existing buildings:
items.text: We assess the stairs and available space to plan installation with as few necessary alterations as possible.

items.title: Project guidance:
items.text: We advise you on the solution, placement and installation requirements.

items.title: Greater independence:
items.text: Helps users move between floors with less reliance on assistance from others.

items.title: Improved access:
items.text: Makes upper and lower floors more accessible for people with limited mobility.

items.title: A tailored solution:
items.text: Planned with the building and the user's specific needs in mind.

intro.title: Escalators and Moving Walkways
intro.description: Escalators and moving walkways support continuous passenger flow in buildings with high foot traffic. Canaj Lift provides solutions tailored to shopping centres, airports, hotels, stations and other public and commercial facilities.

escalators.title: Escalators
escalators.description: Escalators connect different levels and help organize visitor circulation in multi-storey spaces.

items.title: For high-traffic buildings:
items.text: Solutions for shopping centres, airports, hotels and public spaces.

items.title: Designed for the building:
items.text: Configuration is determined by the layout, floor-to-floor height and traffic requirements.

walkways.title: Moving Walkways
walkways.description: Moving walkways make it easier to travel along long corridors or between areas of a building, supporting the flow of visitors.

items.title: Movement over longer distances:
items.text: Suitable for corridors, terminals and large spaces with continuous traffic.

items.title: Different configurations:
items.text: Depending on the project, a solution can be planned for horizontal or inclined travel.

installation.title: Planning and Installation
installation.description: Selecting the right equipment starts with assessing the building, expected traffic and available space.

items.title: Technical assessment:
items.text: We review the location, user circulation and installation conditions.

items.title: Project integration:
items.text: We coordinate the solution with the building's architectural and functional requirements.

tailored.title: Solutions for Your Building
tailored.description: Every building has specific space and circulation requirements. We help you determine the right type and configuration.

items.title: For new buildings:
items.text: Planning during the design stage helps integrate the equipment into the building's circulation.

items.title: For existing facilities:
items.text: We assess the space and technical conditions to identify installation or modernization options.

items.title: Easier circulation:
items.text: Help move visitors between floors or along long spaces.

items.title: Practical use of space:
items.text: Their integration can improve movement planning in public and commercial buildings.

items.title: Tailored solutions:
items.text: The type and configuration are selected according to the project and building requirements.

intro.title: Industrial Elevators
intro.description: Industrial elevators support the movement of personnel and loads between levels in production facilities, warehouses and logistics spaces. Canaj Lift plans solutions around load requirements, usage intensity and site conditions.

elevators.title: Elevators for Industrial Environments
elevators.description: Designed to support daily operations in factories, workshops and logistics facilities.

items.title: For intensive use:
items.text: The configuration is tailored to the work pace and requirements of the facility.

items.title: Based on load and space:
items.text: Capacity and dimensions are determined by the goods and installation conditions.

freight.title: Transporting Goods and Equipment
freight.description: Goods-lift solutions enable the vertical movement of loads, materials and equipment within a facility.

items.title: For warehouses and production:
items.text: Help move goods between work areas and levels of the facility.

items.title: Fits the workflow:
items.text: The solution is planned around loading methods and the flow of work.

installation.title: Technical Planning and Installation
installation.description: A technical assessment helps determine a suitable system for the facility, load and operating conditions.

items.title: Facility assessment:
items.text: We review the available space, levels, load and expected usage intensity.

items.title: Operational integration:
items.text: Placement is planned to support the movement of personnel or goods within the facility.

tailored.title: Solutions for Industrial Requirements
tailored.description: Every industrial environment has different processes and conditions. The solution is determined after reviewing the project and facility requirements.

items.title: Factories and workshops:
items.text: We plan elevators around production-area layouts and transport needs.

items.title: Warehousing and logistics:
items.text: We tailor the solution to the movement of goods, equipment and materials between levels.

items.title: Supports daily operations:
items.text: Makes it easier to move personnel and loads around the facility.

items.title: More organized flow:
items.text: Helps connect different levels and work areas.

items.title: Purpose-built design:
items.text: Capacity and configuration are tailored to usage requirements.

intro.title: Car Elevators
intro.description: At Canaj Lift, we provide advanced, reliable solutions for parking and transporting vehicles. Our car elevators are designed for commercial, residential and industrial buildings, making efficient use of available space. We offer both electric and hydraulic car elevators.

electric.title: Electric Car Elevators
electric.description: Electric car elevators are suitable for multi-storey buildings and the fast, efficient transport of vehicles. Their key advantages include:

advantages.title: Speed and efficiency:
advantages.text: Electric technology offers high speed and low energy consumption, making vehicle transport fast and reliable.

advantages.title: Advanced control:
advantages.text: Electronic control systems ensure stable, precise operation while minimizing vibration and noise.

advantages.title: High performance:
advantages.text: Electric elevators handle heavy loads and deliver consistent performance in varied operating conditions.

hydraulic.title: Hydraulic Car Elevators
hydraulic.description: Hydraulic car elevators are a suitable choice for low-rise buildings and for stable, safe vehicle transport. Their key advantages include:

advantages.title: Easier installation:
advantages.text: They require simpler installation and less space, making them suitable for low-rise buildings and space-constrained sites.

advantages.title: Stability and durability:
advantages.text: Hydraulic technology provides smooth, stable movement for transporting vehicles in varied operating conditions.

advantages.title: Lower maintenance costs:
advantages.text: Hydraulic elevators have lower maintenance costs and are known for long-term durability and reliability.

solutions.title: Tailored Solutions for Every Need
solutions.description: At Canaj Lift, we provide customized car elevator solutions for:

items.title: Residential buildings:
items.text: Comfortable, safe solutions for residents who need convenient and efficient parking.

items.title: Commercial buildings:
items.text: For offices and shopping centres, we provide elevators designed for intensive use and reliable operation.

items.title: Garages and depots:
items.text: Robust, durable solutions for parking facilities and industrial depots, tailored to project requirements.

items.title: Efficient use of space:
items.text: Car elevators help maximize the available parking space in your building.

items.title: Increased property value:
items.text: Modern parking solutions can increase the value and appeal of your property.

items.title: Convenience and ease:
items.text: Our elevators make parking and retrieving your car quick and easy, improving the user experience.

safety.title: Safety and Quality
safety.description: Our car elevators are built to the highest safety and quality standards. We use quality components and advanced technology to ensure safe, efficient operation over the long term.
safety.contact: Contact us today to learn more about our car elevators and find out how we can help bring your project to life.

intro.title: Freight Elevators
intro.description: At Canaj Lift, we understand the importance of efficiency and reliability in moving goods. Our freight elevators are designed for diverse industry needs, providing robust, durable solutions for heavy and bulky loads. We offer a wide range of freight elevators and platforms, including electric and hydraulic models.

electric.title: Electric Freight Elevators
electric.description: Electric freight elevators are ideal for multi-storey buildings and transporting large, heavy loads. Their key advantages include:

advantages.title: High load capacity:
advantages.text: Designed for heavy loads, these elevators are suitable for industrial and commercial use.

advantages.title: Speed and efficiency:
advantages.text: Electric technology delivers high speed and efficiency, reducing wait times and increasing productivity.

advantages.title: Durability and reliability:
advantages.text: Quality components and robust construction provide consistent, reliable performance in varied operating conditions.

hydraulic.title: Hydraulic Freight Elevators
hydraulic.description: Hydraulic freight elevators are suitable for low-rise buildings and loads that require stable, safe transportation. Their key advantages include:

advantages.title: Lower installation cost:
advantages.text: Hydraulic elevators generally cost less to install and maintain than electric models.

advantages.title: Stable transportation:
advantages.text: Hydraulic systems provide a smooth, stable ride for heavy and bulky loads.

advantages.title: Flexibility and versatility:
advantages.text: Suitable for a wide range of applications, from warehouses and depots to factories and commercial buildings.

platforms.title: Goods Platforms
platforms.description: In addition to traditional freight elevators, we offer electric and hydraulic platforms for moving goods. They are designed to provide maximum flexibility and efficiency when handling different loads:

advantages.title: Electric goods platforms:
advantages.text: Deliver high performance and energy efficiency, making them suitable for continuous use and heavy loads.

advantages.title: Hydraulic goods platforms:
advantages.text: Provide high stability and durability, ideal for a range of industrial and commercial environments.

solutions.title: Tailored Solutions for Every Need
solutions.description: At Canaj Lift, we provide customized solutions for each client's specific needs. Whether you need a high-capacity elevator for heavy loads or a flexible platform for moving goods, we have the right solution.

safety.title: Safety and Quality
safety.description: All our freight elevators and platforms are built to the highest safety and quality standards. We use quality materials and the latest technologies to ensure safe, efficient operation over the long term.
safety.contact: Contact us today to learn more about our freight elevators and platforms and find out how we can help bring your project to life.

intro.title: Passenger Elevators
intro.description: At Canaj Lift, we are committed to providing passenger elevators that meet and exceed our clients' expectations. Our elevators are designed for a smooth, safe and comfortable ride, using the latest technologies and the highest industry standards.

electric.title: Electric Elevators
electric.description: Electric elevators are ideal for multi-storey buildings, offering high speeds and energy efficiency. Their key advantages include:

advantages.title: Speed and efficiency:
advantages.text: Electric elevators are ideal for tall buildings where passengers need to be transported quickly.

advantages.title: Advanced technology:
advantages.text: Advanced motors and inverters provide a smooth, consistent ride.

advantages.title: High performance:
advantages.text: Electric elevators handle heavy loads and deliver excellent performance across a range of operating conditions.

hydraulic.title: Hydraulic Elevators
hydraulic.description: Hydraulic elevators are an excellent choice for low-rise buildings, offering high reliability and durability. Their key advantages include:

advantages.title: Lower installation cost:
advantages.text: Hydraulic elevators generally have lower installation and maintenance costs, making them suitable for low- and mid-rise buildings.

advantages.title: Versatile applications:
advantages.text: They can be used in a wide range of settings, from residential to commercial buildings.

advantages.title: Stability and durability:
advantages.text: Hydraulic systems offer excellent stability and are known for their long service life.

solutions.title: Tailored Solutions for Every Need
solutions.description: At Canaj Lift, we understand that every building and project has unique requirements. That's why we offer tailored electric and hydraulic elevator solutions for:

items.title: Residential buildings:
items.text: Our elevators provide residents with a smooth, safe ride while adding value and comfort to your building.

items.title: Commercial buildings:
items.text: For offices and commercial spaces, we provide reliable, efficient elevators that can handle high passenger volumes.

items.title: Low- and high-rise buildings:
items.text: Whether you need an elevator for a multi-storey building or a low-rise property, we have the right solution.

safety.title: Safety and Quality
safety.description: All our elevators are built to the highest safety and quality standards. We use high-quality components and advanced technology to ensure safe, efficient operation over the long term.
safety.contact: Contact us today to learn more about our passenger elevators and find out how we can help bring your project to life.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: Questions about required documentation, installation timelines or maintenance contracts? Contact our engineering team.

documents.question: What documents do I need to install an elevator?
documents.answer: You need a building permit for the property that specifies and includes the elevator installation.

products.question: What types of elevators do you offer?
products.answer: We offer passenger elevators (electric and hydraulic), freight elevators and platforms, car elevators, home lifts, escalators and moving walkways, stairlifts, and industrial elevators.

maintenance.question: What is included in your maintenance service?
maintenance.answer: We create tailored preventive maintenance plans for over 400 elevators, regularly inspect safety components and provide 24/7 emergency service backed by a permanent stock of original spare parts.

modernization.question: Do you modernize existing elevators?
modernization.answer: Yes. We provide complete modernization through digital upgrades, process automation and replacement of worn components to meet current European standards.

quote.question: How can I get a quote for an elevator?
quote.answer: Contact us through our contact page, call +355 69 604 2852 or email info{'@'}canajlift.al to arrange a technical assessment of your project.
